B3_definition.code: experiments/inference_cf_ttls_r1.py process_row arm ('T2A','LN','CE',True); reused: ttls.Episode(variable='LN'), ttls.ce_terms, ttls.preservation_term, ttls.select_candidates, ttls.stable_positions, ttls.displacement, episodic_tta.forced_decode; theta0 branches via experiments/inference_cf_ttls_r1r.theta0_branches (byte-identical TTLS-R1 code path)
B3_definition.trainables: 194 decoder LayerNorm affine tensors, 248320 scalars, fresh fp32 masters per utterance (LNGuard), bf16 functional_call
B3_definition.loss: L = L_A2_CE(y_A; y_A_valid_mask, cB prompt) + 1.0 * mean_{t in S} KL(p_theta0(.|y_B[:t], audio, cB) || p_theta(.|y_B[:t], audio, cB)) over the allowed vocabulary (soft_auto_tta.allowed_log_probs / kl_terms); if y_A == y_B the CE logits are reused for P; empty S -> P = 0 * sum(logits)
B3_definition.stable_set: S = {t : y_B_valid_mask[t] and p_theta0(y_B[t]) >= 0.5 and t not in M}, M = TTLS-R1 frozen candidate rule (cB/cE x clean/null-audio branches, embedded partition, UTF-8 prefix completeness, tau = log 10)
B3_definition.final_decode: materialize effective bf16 LN state, forced-ZH greedy cap 200 (episodic_tta.forced_decode), exact LNGuard restore
B3_definition.references: none; y_A is the theta0 AUTO pseudo-transcript, y_B the theta0 forced decode

regression_oracle.population: FIXED100 subset, frozen rule: every TTLS-R1 row whose sealed B2 or T2A tokens differ from y_B, plus the first two rows (by index) where neither differs
checks_exact: theta0 candidates / stable set == sealed TTLS-R1 row
B3 tokens, termination, losses, parts, grad_l2, master_delta_l2 == sealed TTLS-R1 T2A
A2-only Episode(LN) final fp32 masters == archived A2 masters and decode == sealed A2

evaluation.references: NEW200 role references opened only after the committed A2P-DEV200 output seal
evaluation.metrics: canonical csasr.evaluation via the TTLS-R1 evaluator primitives (PIER, MER, EN-WER, ZH-CER, POI transitions, matrix-ZH retention, outside-POI harm, EOS/truncation events) + the TTLS-R1R frozen lexical split
evaluation.lexical_event: maximal run of consecutive reference POI indices corrected (or corrupted) together in one utterance
evaluation.termination_changed_row: row where the system termination differs from B0, or eos-recovery / premature-eos holds for B2 or B3

decision_rule.notation: N2 = new ZH corruptions of B2 vs B0; N3 = of B3 vs B0; D = N2 - N3; per-utterance d_u = newZH_B2(u) - newZH_B3(u)
decision_rule.INVALID: any integrity failure (regression oracle, B0/B1/B2 reuse identity, reset, non-LN change, missing rows, seal)
decision_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: D <= 0, or genuine (else all-POI) correction retention < 0.5 when assessable, or MER(B3) > MER(B2) + 0.005

BROAD_SUPPORT.3_breadth: #utterances d_u > 0 >= 5, #dialogues with positive dialogue sum >= 4, and #utterances d_u > 0 >= 2 * #utterances d_u < 0
BROAD_SUPPORT.4_concentration: largest single-utterance share of sum_{d_u>0} d_u <= 0.5; D > 0 in >= 18 of 20 leave-one-dialogue-out panels; D restricted to non-termination-changed rows >= 5
BROAD_SUPPORT.5_retention: if B2 genuine-lexical POI corrections >= 3: fraction retained by B3 >= 0.8; else if B2 POI corrections >= 3: all-correction retention >= 0.8; else not assessable (passes, reported)
BROAD_SUPPORT.6_safety_vs_B2: MER(B3) <= MER(B2) + 0.002, PIER(B3) <= PIER(B2) + 0.01, new severe truncations and added caps (vs B0) of B3 <= those of B2
BROAD_SUPPORT.7_vs_AUTO: MER(B3) < MER(B1) and ZH-CER(B3) < ZH-CER(B1); PIER/EN-WER gap reported as the trade-off

decision_rule.note: every verdict is exposed-development evidence; FULL300 aggregates and fixed100 are secondary and never enter the rule
